maya: Quick sync 8: need one hero chart + one economics chart for the launch page and a low-friction CTA. Can we lock concepts today so design can mock?

jon: Use placeholders for public copy: <P95_MS>, <COST_PER_1K>. Ill drop a provisional CSV by 11:00.

sergio: Chart idea hero = routing waterfall (percent served by low-cost variants) with p95 band overlay. Econ chart = cost per 1k tokens by model+quant bars.

elaine: Hero lines (short): 1) "Same outputs. Lower spend." 2) "Predictable latency. Better unit economics." Prefer #1 for clarity.

katie: CTA options: "Get a quick cost chart" vs "See a benchmark for your app". Lower friction = first. A/B test both.

alex: SDR one-liner: "We can show a 1-slide cost chart for your app in 10 min  no demo required." Rebuttal for "we run infra": "Great  we complement infra tuning; share a trace and we'll overlay a cost chart."

maya: Jon, please confirm CSV cols (suggested: model, variant, quant, workload, p50_ms, p95_ms, throughput_tps, cost_per_1k, tokens_per_req, notes). Also legal wants footnote: "Results vary by workload."

jon: Confirmed columns. I'll add a methodology line for the deck: hardware, batching, caching settings. Post approved numbers by EOD.

sergio: Design notes: Redwood green for positive, muted gray baseline, p95 callouts, small methodology footnote. I'll mock PNG + SVG.

maya: Timeline: concepts locked today -> designs tomorrow AM -> landing copy + deck by Friday. :thumbsup:
